prompts.title: Deposit and late policy
prompts.summary: A clear deposit, late and no-show policy, and the text you send after a no-show.
prompts.prompt: Write a booking policy for [business]: deposit [$, refundable or not, when], late arrival (grace period [min], what happens after), no-shows, cancellations ([hours] notice), and fills older than [weeks]. Friendly and firm. Then the text I send after a no-show.
prompts.use: Put it on your booking page and in the confirmation.

prompts.title: Set pricing
prompts.summary: Prices sets by length, shape and art from your time and target hourly rate.
prompts.prompt: Price nail sets for [business]. Target per hour [$]. Time: short set [min], medium [ ], long [ ], extra for shapes [ ], art per nail by level [ ]. Product cost per set [$]. Give a menu and an art price guide with three levels.
prompts.use: Show the art guide when they send an inspo photo.

prompts.title: Close-up reel
prompts.summary: A 10-second close-up reel brief for one set.
prompts.prompt: Write a 10-second reel brief for a [set] at [business]: the first second (the hand turning in light), three close-ups, on-screen words (five at most), and a caption with the set name, price and how to book.
prompts.use: Film by the window after every set you love.
